strings.en: Kyosuke, got a minute?
Captain Amuro...
About Excellen... I'm sorry.
...Yes. I had a feeling it might come to this.
But it's only just begun, hasn't it?
Huh...?
She wasn't our enemy to begin with.
Maybe she's just lost herself because of something like the
mind-control device the Meganoids used down on the surface.
(He's not wrong...
But... the root of it must lie much deeper than we imagine...)
Is that... the Captain and Nanbu?
Hey, Kyosuke. You've been through... a lot, huh?
Yeah... I finally saw her again... and that's how it went.
And I've got no idea how she's tied to that red one... Alchemie.
Cheer up. At least she seems to be okay.
Right... At least it means there's still a chance.
We have to get her back somehow. Until then, all we can do is fight.
(Excellen... Where are you now...?)
Whew, we've still got a mountain of problems.
Looks like we'll reach Sasebo soon. I wonder if the Nadesico's fixed...
They said its main computer was acting up...
Hope it's fixed by the time we get there.
If it's not, we just barge in with our mechanics too
and fix it ourselves.
Joe, there you go being reckless again. Brute force isn't everything.
Anyway, at Sasebo, Commander Hazuki, Captain Quattro, and I
plan to visit the Nadesico.
I wanna go too. Last time, I never got the chance to hit the hot springs.
Koji, honestly, that's all you think about...
Hot springs aside... we fight together, but we hardly interact.
It might be good to take this chance to have a look at the Nadesico.
That's the Captain for ya, he gets it! Right, Koji?
Yeah. The Nadesico's full of beauties... I can't wait.
Ko~ji~
Is that okay, Captain?
We've fought nonstop. Even touring a ship in our unit is a nice change.
And it helps the Nadesico crew's morale... is that it?
That's the idea.
So the surface has places like this.
It seems you've taken a liking to the surface, Lord Drake.
...Indeed...
Lord Drake?
...Who do you think led us to this surface? Shot Weapon?
That woman... from before?
Indeed... We were driven out of Byston Well...
To conquer the surface without knowing who is behind it all...
makes me feel as though I've become a fool.
Surely not. ...Lord Drake, securing our footing must come first.
That woman who meddled with us and the rest can wait until after.
Indeed... And where are they?
We've located them. ...It's at the far western edge of the Pacific.
Good. They'll be a fitting foe for dispelling this unease.
Shot, make no mistakes, understood?
Yes, sir. I've prepared a new model as well... We will not fail.
Everyone, it's been too long. Welcome to the Nadesico.
Even with the Nadesico in dock, I apologize for all of us
barging in like this.
Not at all. Considering the trouble we caused you in that last battle,
letting you all unwind on the Nadesico is the least we can do...
Oh my, welcome! Three Captains, and the hot-blooded Lieutenant too?
And Mr. Handsome as well. Can I get you anything to drink?
Come on, this isn't some bar.
Pardon the intrusion.
I'd rather you didn't call me handsome...
Hmm, and where is everyone else?
Hm? Looks like one of the Nadesico crew just showed them around...
We came to the bridge first to pay our respects to Captain Misumaru, but...
It seems Captain Misumaru has stepped out.
...And your operator, Hoshino, too.
W-Well... about that...
She said she was going to get ready to welcome you all, and that was it...
Honestly, she has no sense of what it means to be captain!
Heh, that's just like her...
By the way, how are the Nadesico's main computer adjustments going?
Well, we've run into a bit of a problem...
If we can't fix it quickly, a Federation Forces work crew
will forcibly wipe Omoikane's memory...
That's troubling... If all the combat data up to now
were erased as well, it would be a great loss for us.
We have pinned down the cause of the trouble, but...
...So there's some problem in solving it?
If you don't mind, could you explain? If there's any way we can help...
Explain it simply... you say? Dr. Inez is never around at times like this...
No need to worry.
Ms. Fressange? Over the ship's PA...?
Wheee...
Why? What? Nadesico.
Hey, everybody, gather 'round! It's time for the secrets of the Nadesico!
...Gather 'round.
Wh-What is this...
...How should we respond to this, Amuro?
For now... it seems all we can do is watch.
Yurika... So this is what you meant by getting ready...
The captain herself went to all this trouble... for us?
...I doubt she needed to build a set...
...She's absolutely doing this for her own fun...
Does everyone know how the Nadesico runs?
Ummm, Big Sister, I don't know!
Hey, hey, why can't the Nadesico move anymore?
S-So cute... No, wait! What are you doing!?
That's because Omoikane has built up a lot of stress.
Ruri-Ruri, you're so cuuute!
I used to be on a show like this too, you know...
Ruri, that's way too flat! And your breath support's a bit weak, too.
Ummm, "Hey, Big Sister, what's this stress thing anyway?"
Huh?
K-Kabuto...?
Tetsuya, the script. It's your line.
...I'm not doing this.
Hey, come on!
He left. ...Well, can't say I blame him.
Hey, weren't you the one who went in saying it looked fun, Hayato?
Come on, now! We're on the air!
Koji, take Tetsuya's place and keep going!
Huh? Oh... "Koji, stress means when you get all irritated, right?"
...Wait, why am I saying that to myself?
"But can a machine really get irritated?"
"...I wonder?"
Even Princess Romina... It seems the place the crew showed everyone to...
was the broadcast room...
Ah, that's a good question.
Then let me explain about the Nadesico's main computer, Omoikane.
Come on, this way. Hurry up.
Ah... Wait a sec, my next line...
The Nadesico's main computer, Omoikane, is a learning computer.
Do you understand that?
Ummm, I don't get it. I mean... I'm a bunny, after all...
(Why a bunny...?)
Hey, Vice Captain! How long are you going to let this go on!?
...Well, it's certainly a silly stunt, but the topic is right on point.
Probably Dr. Inez's doing... We'll get there faster if we just listen.
Show, a "learning computer" is a machine that keeps remembering
things that happen, like people and Ferarios do, right?
Hey, Cham, don't interrupt the show.
That's right, it's just like you said over there.
So by gaining combat experience, the Nadesico
can keep choosing more and more efficient responses.
"Oh-ho, I see. But Big Sister, why did Omoikane
get so stressed out?" If it lashes out to blow off steam...
it's got a pretty short fuse, huh?
(An ad-lib... Not bad, Banjo Haran.)
Omoikane remembers a time it broke through
the Federation Forces' defense line before.
"So it learned that the Federation Forces are in the way, huh?"
"Oh, I get it! We're Federation too, so..." Hey, wait, that's not fair!
Hey, Joe Maya! The good boys and girls of the Nadesico are watching!
Stick to the script! Ruri... time to wrap it up, please.
Wrapping up.
...That's right. The Nadesico was very hostile toward the Federation,
so we kept resetting the memories that caused the glitches, but...
Every reset made the irritation pile up more and more, huh?
"And that's how last time happened." Gotcha, Big Sister.
Nice, Hayato. "...But even if we know why, how do we fix it?"
That's why we need your help.
Huh...? Are we to persuade the central computer, Omoikane?
Don't tell me... that's it? Sounds like the important part's next. Dr. Inez?
Yes... All right, playtime's over.
Shall we move on to the next room on our Nadesico tour?
Ruri, Captain, and all our performers, thank you for your hard work.
I never want to do that again.
Oh, it was fun, wasn't it? Even if Tetsuya ran off.
...Oh, Garrison?
My line... was taken by Miss Cham...
Good grief. ...Still, it seems there's a way to solve this.
...I still don't get why they built such an elaborate set, though.
Was this one a success, I wonder? Megumi?
Hmm, it might've flopped a bit.
In any case, Commander... it seems we'd best join them as well.
Indeed. Where have they gone?
It seems they're in the virtual room.
The virtual room?
This is... the virtual room?
Yes. Originally, it's a facility that shows virtual visions
to relieve stress during long voyages, but...
Don't tell me you're gonna make this Omoikane computer dream
so it can blow off stress!?
I doubt that's possible.
I modded it so you can dive into Omoikane's programming.
Debugging, you could call it.
You can mod it like that?
Uri-P, you're amazing!
Heh, believe it or not, I've accessed Omoikane plenty of times.
Its programming's so slick, I never get tired of looking at it.
But how do you debug it in a virtual reality world?
I don't see how.
Well, you'll see once you're in. Hooked up to my host computer,
this simulator turns you guys into first-rate cyber warriors!
...I've got a bad feeling about this.
Hey, instead of all this hassle, why not just wipe the data
clean and start from scratch?
That would be the quick way, I suppose.
Oblivion is the act of forgetting... That's grown-up logic, isn't it?
Just forget anything that's awkward... Grown-ups are so unfair...
The dearer a memory is... the less you can forget it, even if you try...
To erase something like that...
Yeah... Conveniently forgetting everything,
or making someone forget... I can't agree with that either...
...Sometimes it's happier to forget, to not remember.
But human karma won't allow it. ...Along with our cursed memories.
Besides, erasing every combat record so far would be a problem.
It'd mean the Nadesico goes back to being a newborn again.
Yeah, yeah. So we use this machine to get inside Omoikane
and fix it, right?
If it was all set up like this... why didn't you just do it already?
Yeah. Couldn't we have done it on our own...?
You'll see once the debugging starts. Now, put on the virtual helmets.
Wh-What's that?
Bridge to all hands! The Federation work crew has sent notice!
Due to mission requirements, they can't give us any more time...
They say they're boarding the Nadesico to force-initialize Omoikane!
Looks like they finally ran out of patience.
We'd better hurry.
If we don't hurry, they'll mess with the Nadesico however they like!
Commander Hazuki... please hold off the dock's work crew somehow.
Very well, I'll do that.
...Banjo, I'd like your assistants to lend a hand too.
Understood. Beauty, Reika, Toppo, I'm counting on you. Garrison too.
Leave it to me!
But how are we supposed to get in the work crew's way?
You just need to talk to them like normal.
Let's see... We'll ask the Nadesico crew still on the bridge
to lend a hand as well.
All right, we'll hurry and adjust Omoikane. Everyone ready!?
Yeah, I'm counting on you!
Captain... Shouldn't you go to the bridge?
As captain, I will watch over Akito as he works on Omoikane!
That doesn't really follow, but...
Then I'll handle backup...
Thanks!
All right, let's go!
Virtual machiiine! Switch ooon!!
